# Carnival Adventure Provides a Shipload of Support for Vanuatu’s Small Tourism Operators


Aug 3, 2026


Share


Every memorable stay starts with the people who make guests feel welcome.


To help support those operators, Carnival Cruise Line recently donated 600 drinking glasses and 1,500 plates and bowls to Vanuatu’s Department of Tourism for distribution to bungalow and guest house operators across the country’s outer islands.


The donation will help small tourism businesses that have faced economic challenges in recent years, providing practical supplies they can put to use every day as they welcome visitors, serve meals and create memorable experiences for guests.


The donation reflects Carnival Corporation’s ongoing commitment to supporting the destinations it visits and the people who help bring those destinations to life.
